source.title: Call for Applicants - WRC Leader (April 2024)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Regulations Committee Leader, as Antonio Kam is stepping down as the Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee. The WCA would like to take this opportunity to thank Antonio for leading the WRC since November of 2022.


Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the committee. 

**The qualities expected of candidates are:**


* Strong leadership skills
* Attention to detail
* Expert knowledge of Regulations
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good judgment and decision-making skills
* Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **May 15th, 2024, 23:59 UTC.** Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).


**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
3. Ambitions as the WRC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WRC can be found in  [WCA Motion 10.2021.9.](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.9%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf)

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).  


Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会负责人招募（2024 年 4 月）
translation.content:
Antonio Kam 将卸任 WCA 规则委员会负责人，委员会将任命一位新负责人。WCA 借此感谢 Antonio 自 2022 年 11 月以来带领 WRC 所做的工作。

申请人应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周为委员会工作至少 8 小时。

**我们希望申请人具备以下能力：**

* 较强的领导能力。
* 细致认真。
* 精通规则。
* 较强的分析与解决问题的能力。
* 良好的判断力与决策能力。
* 出色的沟通能力。

申请材料提交时间为即日起至 **2024 年 5 月 15 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请将申请私下发送至行政助理团队（assistants@worldcubeassociation.org），并抄送 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

1. 简短的自我介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
3. 担任 WCA 规则委员会负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料。

WRC 的权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 10.2021.9](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.9%20-%20Regulations%20Committee.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，经高级代表和现任委员会/团队负责人投票确认后公布。流程见 [WCA 决议 10.2022.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
